prompt: Stage 3-2. You are at 58 HP after losing three in a row, holding four loose components (two AD, one AP, one defensive) because none of the pairs make the BIS for the 4-cost carry you plan to hit at 4-2. Your 3-cost carry and 2-cost tank are both naked. What do you do with the components?

options.label: Keep holding: the BIS components will come from the 3-4 carousel and you do not want a wasted item
Slam two items now: the AD pair on the 3-cost carry and the AP + defensive into a tank item on the 2-cost tank
Slam only the AD pair on the carry and keep the other two for BIS

explanation:
Four components on the bench at 3-2 while losing is two completed items you are refusing to use, and each loss is costing 8 HP. The HP rule is simple: below roughly 70 HP on a loss streak in stage 3, every pair of components becomes an item this round. The AD pair is a real carry item on a 2-star 3-cost that is already your damage; the AP plus defensive component makes a serviceable tank item for the unit taking the hits. Both stay useful for the whole game because items move freely in planning and a 4-cost carry with two "non-BIS" items beats a 4-cost you never itemised. The 3-4 carousel is two rounds and 16 HP away.

Slamming only one item is the compromise that still loses: the frontline stays naked and you keep losing 8 HP, now for the sake of one hypothetical BIS. BIS is a preference, not a requirement, and it costs HP you do not have to hold out for it.
principle: Below 70 HP on a loss streak, components on the bench are HP you are choosing to lose.
commonMistake: Waiting for perfect items on a carry you have not found yet, while the carry you have fights with nothing.
